"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed HTTP-only cookie asserting the user's login state."""
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    payload = f"{user_id}.{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": f"{payload}.{signature}",
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Strict",
        "path": "/",
    }
